Open Positions

Full Stack Developer

About Ultra

ULTRA, a global technology company, is transforming global trade compliance by automating the entire customs clearance process.

In an era of increasing complexity in global trade and supply chains, our platform provides dynamic, scalable, and cost-efficient solutions that enable seamless collaboration between economic operators, logistics providers, and government regulators.

Through Publican, Ultra provides governments with a powerful platform designed to improve transparency, streamline regulatory processes, and enable more efficient and secure international trade. Building on this foundation, Publican World extends these capabilities to the private sector — an AI-powered compliance platform designed for customs brokers, freight forwarders, and 3PLs, automating classification, validation, and shipment workflows.


The Role

As a Full Stack Developer, you will play a pivotal role in our core team, building the products and platforms that define our company. You will be responsible for:

  • Developing high-scale solutions within a complex, data-driven environment.
  • Writing elegant, reusable, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Driving excellence within the team by sharing knowledge and maintaining high development standards.
  • Ensuring code quality through Unit Testing and robust engineering practices.



What We Are Looking For

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Full Stack development.
  • Deep knowledge and hands-on experience with C# and .NET Core.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and extensive experience working with APIs and Web Services.
  • Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/jQuery.
  • Experience working with Jira in an Agile environment.
  • High proficiency in English (both written and verbal) and great interpersonal skills.
  • A strong team player who is self-motivated and an independent learner.
  • Experience with React - Advantage
  • Familiarity with microservices and distributed architectures - Advantage
